categories.main_business_segments: SCREEN Holdings operates four main business segments: Semiconductor Production Equipment (SPE), Graphic Arts Equipment (GA), Display Production and Coating Equipment (FT), and Printed Circuit Board-related Equipment (PE). The company also engages in new business fields such as advanced semiconductor packaging, life sciences, and hydrogen-related products, as well as software and document production services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include surface processing, direct imaging, and image processing, which are integrated across its product lines. In SPE, it specializes in wafer cleaning, coating, and thermal processing technologies. GA leverages advanced inkjet and digital printing technologies, while FT focuses on coating and developing equipment for OLED and LCD displays. PE emphasizes high-precision direct imaging for printed circuit boards. R&D is also directed at environmental performance, water management, and next-generation device manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global semiconductor manufacturers, especially foundries and memory makers, as well as commercial and packaging printing companies, display panel manufacturers, and PCB producers. The end markets are primarily the semiconductor, electronics, display, and printing industries, with a strong focus on advanced technology nodes and high-performance applications such as AI, data centers, and 5G infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: SCREEN Holdings has a global footprint, with major operations in Japan, Taiwan, China, South Korea, the United States, and Europe. In FY2025, sales were concentrated in China (42.4%), Taiwan (18.1%), Japan (14.4%), the US (10.3%), Europe (5.4%), Korea (5.1%), and other regions (4.3%). Manufacturing and R&D bases are primarily in Japan, with significant overseas subsidiaries and service centers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the supply chain, providing critical manufacturing equipment and solutions to upstream component/material suppliers and downstream device manufacturers in the semiconductor, display, and electronics industries. It is a key supplier to leading fabs and electronics manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the competitiveness of core businesses, expanding global R&D collaboration, and investing in growth areas such as advanced packaging, life sciences, and hydrogen technologies. The company emphasizes innovation management, digital transformation (DX), sustainability (GHG reduction, green products), and human capital development. R&D spending is focused on next-generation semiconductor equipment, environmental solutions, and new business creation.
categories.revenue_model: SCREEN Holdings generates revenue primarily through the sale of capital equipment (new installations), recurring revenue from maintenance, consumables, and upgrades (post-sales), and service contracts. Additional revenue streams include software licensing, consulting, and, in new business areas, potential licensing or contract manufacturing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the semiconductor equipment sector, key competitors include Tokyo Electron, Lam Research, and Applied Materials. SCREEN is a global leader in wafer cleaning equipment, with a significant market share (42% in single-wafer cleaning in 2024). In printing and display equipment, it competes with companies like Canon, Ricoh, and other specialized equipment makers. The company is positioned as a technology-driven, solution-oriented supplier with strong market presence in Asia.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales reached ¥625.3 billion (approx. $4.1 billion), with operating profit of ¥135.7 billion and net income attributable to shareholders of ¥99.5 billion. The company has demonstrated robust growth, with sales increasing 23.8% year-on-year and record-high profitability. The balance sheet is strong, with an equity ratio of 62.7% and over 6,400 employees worldwide.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SCREEN Holdings differentiates itself through advanced process technologies, high reliability, and strong customer support, particularly in semiconductor cleaning and direct imaging. The company emphasizes environmental performance, productivity, and innovation, offering solutions that address both technological and sustainability challenges. Its ability to provide integrated, high-precision equipment and global service is a key value driver for customers seeking advanced manufacturing capabilities.
